# Derived regression fixture for the data-lost restoration contract on
# non-resumable subscriptions: after code 1101 the Gateway has dropped every
# data subscription, so a ResumeNever quote stream must close with
# ErrResumeRequired instead of staying open on a dead stream. Handshake,
# quote, and 1100/1101 error shapes reuse quote_stream_gap_1101.txt
# (server_version 200); the trailing current_time exchange proves the close
# happened on the 1101 frame while the connection was still up, not as a
# side effect of the transcript disconnect.
handshake {"server_version":200,"connection_time":"20260405 12:00:00 CET"}
server managed_accounts {"accounts":["DU12345"]}
server next_valid_id {"order_id":1001}
client req_quote {"req_id":"$req1","contract":{"symbol":"AAPL","sec_type":"STK","exchange":"SMART","currency":"USD","primary_exchange":"","local_symbol":""},"snapshot":false,"generic_ticks":[]}
server tick_price {"req_id":"$req1","field":1,"price":"189.10"}
server api_error {"req_id":0,"code":1100,"message":"Connectivity between IB and TWS has been lost"}
server api_error {"req_id":0,"code":1101,"message":"Connectivity between IB and TWS has been restored - data lost"}
client req_current_time {}
server current_time {"time":"1783207046"}
disconnect
